scripts.build:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs build 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs build "pnpm run build && pnpm run build:manager"
scripts.tests:all: pnpm run build:all && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run quality:check:all" "pnpm run infra:check:all" "pnpm run test:all"
scripts.quality:check:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs quality 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs quality "pnpm run quality:format:check:all && pnpm run quality:lint:check:all && pnpm run quality:type:all && pnpm run quality:osv:check"
scripts.quality:format:check:all: pnpm run quality:format:check:sdk && pnpm run quality:format:check:manager && pnpm run quality:format:check:node && pnpm run quality:terraform:format:check
scripts.quality:format:fix:all: pnpm run quality:format:fix:sdk && pnpm run quality:format:fix:manager && pnpm run quality:format:fix:node && pnpm run quality:terraform:format:fix
scripts.quality:lint:check:all: pnpm run quality:lint:check:sdk && pnpm run quality:lint:check:manager
scripts.quality:lint:fix:all: pnpm run quality:lint:fix:sdk && pnpm run quality:lint:fix:manager
scripts.quality:type:all: pnpm run quality:type:node && pnpm run quality:type:sdk && pnpm run quality:type:ts
scripts.security:check:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs security 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs security "pnpm run security:audit:all && pnpm run security:gitleaks:check && pnpm run security:codeql:check:all && pnpm run security:trivy:check && pnpm run security:semgrep:check"
scripts.security:codeql:check:all: pnpm run security:codeql:check:ts && pnpm run security:codeql:check:sdk && pnpm run security:codeql:check:node && pnpm run security:codeql:check:manager
scripts.security:gitleaks:check: ROOT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && mkdir -p temp && gitleaks git --config "$ROOT_DIR/.gitleaks.toml" --verbose --redact --exit-code 1 --report-format json --report-path temp/gitleaks-report.json "$ROOT_DIR"
scripts.security:audit:all: pnpm run security:audit:l2 && pnpm run security:audit:sdk && pnpm run security:audit:node && pnpm run security:audit:ts
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit:all && pnpm run test:unit:coverage:all && pnpm run test:integration:all && pnpm run test:e2e:all
scripts.test:unit:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs unit 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs unit "pnpm run test:unit:node && pnpm run test:unit:sdk && pnpm run test:unit:ts && pnpm run test:unit:manager"
scripts.test:unit:node: pnpm --dir midgard-node exec vitest run --root .. --config vitest/node.unit.config.mts midgard-node/tests/unit
scripts.test:integration:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs integration 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs integration "pnpm run test:integration:node && pnpm run test:integration:sdk"
scripts.test:integration:node: pnpm --dir midgard-node exec vitest run --root .. --config vitest/node.integration.config.mts midgard-node/tests/integration
scripts.test:integration:node:tx-ingress: pnpm --dir midgard-node exec vitest run --root .. --config vitest/node.integration.config.mts midgard-node/tests/integration/tx-ingress-processor.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:sdk: pnpm --dir midgard-node exec vitest run --root .. --config vitest/sdk.integration.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e:all: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs e2e 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs e2e "pnpm run test:legacy && pnpm run test:e2e:node:all"
scripts.test:e2e:node:all: pnpm run test:e2e:node:redis-ingress && pnpm run test:e2e:node:pipeline && pnpm run test:e2e:node:faucet
scripts.test:legacy:all: pnpm --dir midgard-node run test && pnpm --dir midgard-sdk run test && pnpm --dir midgard-ts run test
scripts.test:unit:coverage:node: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs node-coverage 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs node-coverage "pnpm --dir midgard-node exec vitest run --root .. --config vitest/node.coverage.config.mts --coverage"
scripts.test:unit:coverage:sdk: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs sdk-coverage 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs sdk-coverage "vitest run --config vitest/sdk.coverage.config.mts --coverage"
scripts.test:unit:coverage:ts: node ../scripts/readme/refresh-badges.mjs ts-coverage 1 && node ../scripts/readme/run-badged-command.mjs ts-coverage "vitest run --config vitest/ts.coverage.config.mts --coverage"
scripts.test:unit:coverage:all: pnpm run test:unit:coverage:node && pnpm run test:unit:coverage:sdk && pnpm run test:unit:coverage:ts
